candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get diarrhoea for 3 days. Pikin dey restless or e dey irritable. Eye dey sunken. Skin wey I pinch come back normal. E dey drink water or breastfeed well. Caregiver talk say pikin never get blood for stool. E never convulse before, e no dey convulse now. Pikin no dey vomit everything. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. Pikin no get cough or any wahala for breathing. Pikin no get ear problem. Pikin no get fever.
